nodes.label: Multi-QR settings API (getQrUri/setQrUri/getAllQrUris)
nodes.rationale: Three fixed per-method settings keys (qr_gcash/qr_maya/qr_bpi) replace the single legacy gcash_qr_uri key; a schema migration copies existing data forward. Payment buttons are built dynamically only from methods that have an uploaded QR.

nodes.label: export-csv-shared per-item row builder (Flavor column)
nodes.rationale: Export switches to one CSV row per item so variant/flavor is filterable in a spreadsheet. Transaction-level fields repeat per row; the # column lets rows be grouped back into transactions. Shared logic is extracted because export-csv.ts and export-csv.web.ts previously duplicated it verbatim.

nodes.label: Payment QR refresh fix (useFocusEffect)
nodes.rationale: payment.tsx loaded QR codes once on mount with useEffect; a Payment screen kept alive in the navigation stack never saw QRs uploaded afterward. Swapping to useFocusEffect (matching other screens) refetches on focus so newly uploaded methods like Maya appear without restart.

nodes.label: SQLite data model (products, transactions, transaction_items, settings)
nodes.norm_label: sqlite data model (products, transactions, transaction_items, settings)
nodes.rationale: Offline-first: all persistence in local SQLite with no backend. Products are deactivated (is_active), never deleted, to preserve transaction history integrity; transaction_items snapshot product_name and price at time of sale.

nodes.label: product_variants table and composite-key cart items
nodes.norm_label: product_variants table and composite-key cart items
nodes.rationale: Per-variant pricing means the parent product price becomes nullable. Cart items aggregate on a composite productId+variantId key. variant_name is denormalized onto transaction_items so history survives variant deletion/rename. emoji column is abandoned (not dropped, since SQLite pre-3.35 lacks DROP COLUMN).
